sources.entry: RAVE LIVE - Festival light show that locks to the beat of whatever your Mac is playing, with stage lights, lasers and MilkDrop presets. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jedbrnth-eng/rave-live) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: RAVE LIVE is a free, open-source macOS app that turns whatever your Mac is playing into a beat-locked light show with Stage, Classic Visuals, AURORA and MilkDrop modes.
summary.what_it_does: RAVE LIVE captures the audio your Mac is playing (via ScreenCaptureKit, or a microphone or input device) and analyses its tempo, beat and bar line in real time. It drives four modes: a procedural club Stage with LED walls, moving heads and lasers; Classic Visuals with 48 presets and a Shader Lab for custom .metal files; AURORA, a GPU fluid simulation with particles that can react to the mouse or camera; and MILKDROP, which plays MilkDrop presets through projectM with changes locked to the beat. A SHOW mode cycles between these scenes on bar lines. The app includes VJ features such as Syphon output, a fullscreen projector output, MIDI Learn and MIDI clock sync, and an optional synced-lyrics display with a Now Playing card (lyrics are off by default because they query lrclib.net). The README also describes a strobe limit of 3 flashes per second by default, and a demo mode that runs with no music playing.
use_cases: visuals that sync to music playing on a Mac
light show for a party or festival on a laptop
VJ visuals fed into Resolume, VDMX, OBS or MadMapper via Syphon
writing custom Metal fragment shaders as visuals
displaying synced lyrics over a music visualizer
how_to_run: Download RAVE-LIVE.dmg from the latest release, drag RAVE LIVE to Applications, and open it (approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security, since it is not notarized).
Grant Screen & System Audio Recording permission, then quit and reopen the app.
Or run the one-line installer: curl -fsSL <url> | bash (the README gives the command without a full URL).
From source: git clone the repo, cd rave-live, swift test, scripts/make_app.sh, open "build/RAVE LIVE.app".
stack: Python sidecar (optional Beat This! referee, PyTorch)
notable: Beat-locked scheduling: cues, transitions and MilkDrop preset changes land on a real-time beat and bar grid
Optional Beat This! (CPJKU, ISMIR 2024) Python referee corrects beat phase and tempo in the background
149 MilkDrop presets built in, with about 9,800 more downloadable on demand
Shader Lab hot-reloads .metal files dropped into a folder
No account, analytics or telemetry; network use only for the optional preset pack and lyrics
caveats: Mac only; Linux and Windows versions are planned with no date
System audio capture requires macOS 13 Ventura or later; macOS 12 needs a mic, interface or loopback driver such as BlackHole
Pre-release (0.6.0) with rough edges; the app is not notarized by Apple
Flashing lights and strobes can trigger photosensitive seizures; a photosensitivity warning is shown
